summary: Join opted-in membership pages and streams without waiting for an unchanged window

schema.detail: The canonical graph schema is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Explicit TypeScript collection-v1 methods preserve legacy methods. MembershipPaging publishes complete unique pages with authoritative counts even without a matching stream frame; newer frontiers and changed scopes restart attempts.

manual.detail: Subscribe first, then feed page and stream metadata to MembershipPaging. No client activation or daemon capability advertisement is included.

recovery.detail: Delayed older frames cannot roll back accepted pages. Inexact JavaScript integers and inconsistent metadata are refused instead of rounded or guessed.
